title: Accepting the Trait Contract
goal: Implement an unsafe trait using the correct keyword and return value.

source.attribution: adapted from Unsafe Rust: Implementing Unsafe Traits

hints: Unsafe traits require explicit acknowledgment when writing their implementation block.
The capacity function must return the actual length of the internal array.
explanation: Implementing an unsafe trait requires `unsafe impl` so you explicitly accept the trait's safety contract. Omission of `unsafe` yields compiler error `E0200`. Using `dyn impl` is invalid syntax resulting in compiler error `E0407`. Returning `0` or the pointer address compiles with `unsafe impl` but fails test verification.
